_comment: Section 8.2 mechanical non-mutation guardrail for the isolated Live VTO research program. PROTECTED entries are existing production/runtime paths in kscan-app that this program is authorized to READ but never MUTATE. ALLOWED_EXCEPTIONS are additive-only carve-outs inside otherwise-protected trees. The validator (validate-protected-paths.js) fails the check if any changed file in the diff matches a PROTECTED prefix and does not also match an ALLOWED_EXCEPTIONS prefix.
_note_on_docs: docs/ and .github/ are fully protected except for the specific net-new filenames listed in ALLOWED_EXCEPTIONS (the isolated program's own status/authority/risk documents and its one additive CI workflow file). This blocks the isolated program from editing any pre-existing documentation or CI/CD configuration, including the staging/production deploy workflows under .github/workflows/.
